correctness.rationale: Five-term Binet expansion gives 5k/64 constant. Norms of differences of distinct roots are -4,-32,-196,-1152, ensuring an invertible Vandermonde away from 2,3,7. The coefficient valuations are min(v_p(5k),v_R(lambda^k-1)), and the quadratic basis identifies the latter with valuations of B_k and C_k-1. Order-six lambda mod 5 and valuation-one lambda^6-1 yield precise 5-adic lifting. Exact recurrence reduces the infinite GCD to five windows per k; standalone verifier passed 500 k values. No finite-to-infinite inference is used.

value.rationale: A published explicit open problem asks for square-window GCDs for cobalancing numbers. This theorem supplies all p-adic components outside exactly three root-collision primes, identifies explicit prime-five behavior at every sixth window length, and isolates the remaining problem by a natural norm-based obstruction. It is substantive infinite structural information, not a small congruence exercise.
